evidence.quote: there would appear to be an advantage to waiting until developments provide greater confidence.
the appropriate path of policy is likely to remain shallow for several years.
the risks to the return of inflation to our 2 percent target over the medium term are weighted to the downside.

This asymmetry in the capability of policy effectively skews risks to the outlook to the downside.
